title: Returns Centre Standard: Settlement Hold on Store Credit Behind an Open Return
content:
While the Returns & Exchanges return behind a Gift Cards & Store Credit store credit is not yet settled, part of the store credit's returned-order value is held for its settlement and is not paid out in a cash-out. The hold follows the return's status on the cash-out date.

| Status of the return behind the store credit | Settlement hold |
|---|---|
| Authorized, in transit or received | 1 of the returned-order value (all of it) |
| Inspected | 0.5 of the returned-order value (half), rounded half up to the cent |
| Any other status, or the instrument did not come from a return | No settlement hold |

The returned-order value is the store credit's current balance less the refunds loaded onto it from orders paid with it, never below zero. The settlement hold stays on the instrument and is taken off the cash-out amount.

## Illustrations (hypothetical store credit with a returned-order value of 45.25)

| Return status | Settlement hold |
|---|---|
| Authorized | 45.25 |
| In transit | 45.25 |
| Received | 45.25 |
| Inspected | 22.63 (half of 45.25 is 22.625, rounded half up) |
| Settled | none |

A Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card bought by purchase did not come from a return and never carries a settlement hold.
